subject: Class of 2020 Scholarship Awards
overview: Medford Public Schools administrators, counselors, and community partners announced academic, service, and memorial scholarships awarded to graduating seniors from Medford High School and Medford Vocational Technical High School.

items.title: Opening Remarks
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent and Principal D'Alleva congratulated the graduating seniors on their achievements and perseverance during remote school closures.

items.title: Medford Police Patrolman's Association Award
items.summary: Awarded four $1,000 scholarships funded by No Shave November to Evelyn Garcon, Karen Adams, Margaret Tseng, and Emma McGlynn.

items.title: Medford Kiwanis Club Scholarships
items.summary: Presented $2,000 scholarships to Ibn Asa, Emily McDade, Bobby Norton, Melanie Dematia, Noah Light, and Brenna Christensen.

items.title: 4INC Scholarship
items.summary: Awarded a $1,000 scholarship to Jacqueline Madigan to support her pursuit of a nursing degree at Salve Regina University.

items.title: Munoz Lepore and World Language Club Scholarships
items.summary: Presented the Munoz Lepore Spanish scholarship to Nicholas Hollings and Michael Wu, alongside World Language Club awards to Katie Stefani, Shruti Sood, and Catherine Brosnahan.

items.title: Michelina Petrangelo Scholarship
items.summary: Awarded scholarships totaling $9,000 to Italian language students Lang Cheng, Ching Cheng, Audrey Soley, Nick Corrado, Olivia Framini, and Maria Robbins.

items.title: Music Ensemble Scholarships
items.summary: Presented band, chorus, and orchestra scholarships to Connor Parry, Alyssa Gould, and Isabel Vizera.

items.title: Crystal Campbell Medford Strong Spirit Award
items.summary: Presented a $1,500 spirit award to student athlete Jackie Madigan.

items.title: Medford Chamber of Commerce Cheryl White Scholarship
items.summary: Awarded the $2,000 community service scholarship to Jacqueline Madigan.

items.title: UMass Lowell Hoff Scholarship
items.summary: Announced that graduating senior Malika received the Hoff Scholarship to study business marketing and entrepreneurship at UMass Lowell.

items.title: Bunker Hill Community College Presidential Scholarship
items.summary: Awarded full tuition and fee coverage for the freshman fall semester to Kelly Doan.

items.title: MHS and MVTHS PTO Scholarships
items.summary: Awarded $500 essay scholarships to Ebion Abshir, Brenna Christensen, Alex Myles, Kieran Adams, and Jacqueline Madigan.

items.title: Medford High School Alumni Association Scholarship
items.summary: Awarded a $1,000 scholarship to Dorothea Villot.

items.title: Middlesex Federal Scholarships
items.summary: Awarded three $1,000 memorial scholarships honoring John Champy to Ava Urasitz, Frances Flood, and Katherine Sherburn.

items.title: East Cambridge Savings Bank Scholarships
items.summary: Awarded $1,000 scholarships to Evan Liao and Frances Flood.

items.title: Matthew Sorelli Scholarship
items.summary: Presented $1,000 memorial scholarships to cross-country and community-oriented seniors Jacqueline Madigan and John Falco.

items.title: Closing Remarks
items.summary: High school guidance staff concluded the presentation with congratulations and well wishes for the graduating class.
